scope.target: Reuse the exact raw train/valid SHA-256 already computed by one worker during that worker's pinned portable-registry verification.
not_in_scope: skipping mounted input identity, footer, portable registry, or fold checks
trainer, loss, sampler, model, checkpoint, prediction, or grader changes
GPU work, profile, fit, score, provider call, packet build, or upload

terminal_manifest.note: Operator reported 5d81e50c…948054; no corresponding file is present in this workspace, so it is deliberately not bound as a full hash.

v6_measured_io.interpretation: One full duplicate train digest pass is directly measured. The valid repeat started but its progress interval did not produce an exact byte count before the 1800-second cap. Source sizes establish the maximum full pair pass, not a fully observed valid repeat. Memory snapshots do not support OOM or cgroup pressure as the cause.

handoff_contract.scope: one Python worker process and an exact allowlist of raw train/valid canonical paths
handoff_contract.hash: stream complete file once; compare descriptor and path stat identities before and after; require bytes_hashed == original stat size
handoff_contract.authorization: receipt must be issued by this handoff; observed digest must equal both frozen expected SHA-256 and portable-registry SHA-256; current exact stat identity must still match
handoff_contract.consumer: wrap only pinned wnn.portability._content_digest; pinned registry and metadata checks remain active; every miss calls the original full content verifier on current bytes
handoff_contract.cache_persistence: memory only; no digest receipt survives the current worker
handoff_contract.pagecache_advice: initial hash continues the existing page-aligned POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED strict advice path; advice errors abort
handoff_contract.changed_input_behavior: path replacement, mutation, stat drift, missing file, allowlist miss, receipt mismatch, or digest mismatch never reuses the receipt; pinned hash/check rejects changed content

synthetic_measurement.timing_claim: This is an 8 MiB local synthetic-file microbenchmark only; it is not a 35 GB parquet, Kaggle runtime, or fit-throughput forecast.

recipe_boundary: See FROZEN_RECIPE_DIFFERENCE.md. E-522 only removes one duplicate same-worker raw SHA read when exact verified digest/stat conditions hold; scientific recipe and official grader remain fixed.
